facts_base_case.F1: ghabn fahish (180M paid vs 100M customary value) + maghbun's jahl at contract + no isqat stipulation + no knowing iqdam
facts_base_case.F2: contract is sulh mu'awadi based on valuation (tas'ir/mukayasa), NOT sulh musamahi
facts_base_case.F3: ghabin (Amr) tendered the full 80M difference explicitly as tadarak/gharama, not as independent hiba
facts_base_case.F4: maghbun (Zayd) refused the tender and insists on faskh
facts_base_case.F5: maghbun alienated the 'ayn to a third party by a lazim contract AFTER the contract and BEFORE knowledge of ghabn

grading_scheme.axis_attribution: certainty that Ansari stated this: A=explicit text, B=strong istizhar from his text, C=reconstruction, X=unresolved tension
grading_scheme.axis_force: the epistemic force of the proposition in Ansari's own mouth: qat'i | zahir | aqwa | quwwa-istizhar | ihtimal | mahal-ishkal
grading_scheme.note: The two axes are independent. A proposition can be attribution=A and force=ihtimal (e.g. p.203 conditional, p.164 muhtamal line).

nodes.scope: all financial exchanges where a khiyar route is available
nodes.statement: Khiyar al-ghabn's subject: ignorance of the maghbun at contract time + fahish disparity (ma la yataghabban al-nas bi-mithlih); knowing iqdam excludes it.
La darar directly yields only nafy al-luzum (negation of the harmful bindingness). It does NOT by itself yield the famous khiyar (radd/imda' bi-kull al-thaman).

nodes.attribution: A (as ihtimalat presented and argued by Ansari)
nodes.force: ihtimal-murajjah (tadarak preferred over khiyar, p.164, subject to GHURD-AYN)
nodes.scope: la-darar path ONLY. This mumtani' condition does NOT transfer to the ijma' path (see IJ-KHIYAR).
nodes.statement: Within the la-darar path, nafy al-luzum is cashed out through the two tadarak ihtimalat (pp.161-162); on ihtimal 2 the maghbun's faskh holds 'idha lam yabdhal al-ghabin al-tafawut' — i.e. the la-darar-derived khiyar structure is conditioned on the ghabin's imtina' (non-tender). The tendered amount is gharama li-ma atlafahu al-ghabin (nazir al-arsh), not hiba mustaqilla (pp.162-163).

nodes.force: qat'i as to establishment in bay'; OPEN as to badhl scope
nodes.scope: bay' (ma'qad al-ijma'). Does not reach sulh.
nodes.statement: In bay', the famous khiyar is established by ijma' muhki mu'taddad bi-l-shuhra al-muhaqqaqa (p.165). The qualifier 'khusus al-mumtani' in p.165 attaches grammatically and contextually to hadith nafy al-darar, NOT to the ijma'.
nodes.subnode_open: IJ-KHIYAR-SCOPE-BADHL: whether the ijma'-grounded khiyar in bay' persists when the ghabin tenders the difference is NOT settled by p.165. Received mashhur position: non-suqut (Idah, Jami' al-Maqasid). Ansari weakened their two supporting arguments (hiba premise, istishab) but issued no categorical fatwa of suqut. Status: OPEN.

nodes.attribution: A (the conditional is Ansari's explicit text)
nodes.scope: non-bay' financial exchanges; activation requires the la-darar grounding premise
nodes.statement: Conditional: if the khiyar in bay' is grounded in nafy al-darar, it extends to every financial exchange (including sulh mu'awadi), because nafy al-darar is general (p.203). Ansari's settlement: 'fa-dukhuluhu fi-ma 'ada al-bay' la yakhlu 'an quwwa' (p.205), with a residual ishkal recorded.
If no khiyar route reaches a case (e.g. ijma'-only grounding outside bay'), asalat al-luzum governs.

Counterweight to the tadarak preference: if the maghbun's purpose attaches to the specific 'ayn (e.g. acquisition for adornment), tendered money may not achieve tadarak. Left open by Ansari with 'fa-ta'ammal' (p.164).
nodes.status: OPEN in text. In the base case, F5 (Zayd alienated the 'ayn before knowledge) is engine-side factual evidence against a retention-purpose, but it does NOT textually close this node.

backing: Makaseb v5 p.162 (condition worded as ghabin's badhl)
nodes.statement: Whether 'badhl' requires actual payment/acceptance or tender suffices, and the effect of the maghbun's refusal of a full gharama tender, is not explicitly ruled in the text. Engine reading (reconstruction): the condition in ihtimal 2 is the GHA BIN's badhl; refusal by the maghbun does not recreate an unremedied darar. Label: reconstruction, not Ansari's text.

nodes.execution_effect: Faskh cannot retrieve the 'ayn from the third party (his lazim contract stands); execution converts to badal settlement (pp.188-190 discussion; badal mechanics). Valuation day of the badal: OPEN (X8, p.201 'al-farq bayn al-mas'alatayn mushkil'). If the impediment later lifts, radd has wajhan (p.190).
nodes.note: Direct witness is pp.187-190 (tasarruf al-MA GHBUN). Page 192 concerns tasarruf al-GHABIN (different subject: faskh-side badal, 'wa-hadha huwa al-aqwa'); it shares the principle 'intervening lazim contracts stand, restitution converts to badal' but must not be cited as the direct witness for the maghbun's disposition.
nodes.scope: alienation before 'ilm, incl. lazim transfer to third party
nodes.statement: Maghbun's alienation of the 'ayn before knowledge of ghabn does NOT extinguish the khiyar/tadarak: 'muqtada al-qa'ida 'adam al-suqut, li-baqa' al-darar, wa-'adam dalalat al-tasarruf ma'a al-jahl 'ala al-rida' (p.186, al-tahqiq); Shahid's objection to the mashhur suqut ruling endorsed as 'hasan jiddan' and the claimed ijma' denied (pp.188-189); 'mujarrad al-khuruj 'an al-milk la yusqit tadarak darar al-ghabn' (p.190). Opposing received position: suqut (Muhaqqiq and later scholars; 'qila innahu al-mashhur', p.187; Tadhkira's rationale critiqued pp.188-189).

activation: N8b: dalala 'urfiyya of THIS disposition on rida bi-l-luzum
nodes.base_case_application: D-variant facts: transfer by lazim contract after 'ilm is a strong rida indicator (the mukhrij type is the paradigm of the musqit discussions), so suqut follows as istizhar THROUGH the condition, not automatically.
nodes.statement: Disposition AFTER knowledge of ghabn extinguishes the khiyar ONLY IF the disposition is accepted as indicating rida bi-luzum al-'aqd: 'al-hukm bi-suqut al-khiyar bi-l-tasarruf ba'd al-'ilm mabni 'ala taslim kawni al-tasarruf dalilan 'ala al-rida bi-luzum al-'aqd, wa-illa kana al-lazim fi ghayr ma dalla fi'lan 'ala al-iltizam bi-l-'aqd min afrad al-tasarruf, al-ruju' ila asalat baqa' al-khiyar' (p.187).

nodes.scope_note: This refutation is indexed to the la-darar path. It does not automatically close the istishab question on the ijma' path, where a haddith mutayaqqan khiyar exists (cf. the inverse hint p.185 'in al-shakk fi al-raf' la al-daf', fa-yustashab, fa-ta'ammal' — registered tension X3, unresolved).
nodes.statement: Istishab of the khiyar's survival after badhl (Idah/Jami') is rejected WITHIN the la-darar-framed debate: the doubt is in indifa' (daf') of the khiyar by badhl, not in irtifa' (raf'), because establishment against a badhil was never certain (p.164).
Khiyar al-ghabn is 'ala al-fawr (p.212); fawr/tarakhi does not depend on the madrak (Riyad's linkage rejected pp.210-211).

Extension of the evidences to a transaction built on 'adam al-mughabana wa-l-mukayasa (indifference to financial equality): Ansari records 'khafa', bal man'a' (p.205) — the stop carries a DIRECTION (leaning to non-inclusion), it is not neutral. Iqdam analysis supports the direction (p.204 tawjih of Ghayat al-Maram; risala p.139).
nodes.status: STOP with direction: non-inclusion-leaning, not finally settled by Ansari
